events.text: Edward the Elder gave the land then known as Weolingtun, along with West Buckland and Bishops Lydeard, to Bishop Asser.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In a grant of between 899 and 909 Edward the Elder gave the land then known as Weolingtun

events.text: By the time of the Domesday Book of 1086, the name had changed to Walintone.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By the time of the Domesday Book of 1086, the name had changed to Walintone

events.text: By the time of the Domesday Book of 1086, the estate was owned by Gisa (Bishop of Wells).
events.subject: self
events.quote: the estate was owned by Gisa ( Bishop of Wells )
